invests.text: PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 10.4S 90.2E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 10.8S 90.4E, APPROXIMATELY 394 NM WEST OF COCOS ISLANDS. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED (EIR) SATELLITE DEPICTS DEEP CONVECTION DISPLACED BY MODERATE NORTHWESTERLY VERTICAL WIND SHEAR TO THE SOUTHERN PORTION OF AN ELONGATED LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC) EVIDENT IN A 200344Z METOP-C ASCAT PASS. ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS REVEALS A MARGINAL ENVIRONMENT FOR DEVELOPMENT WITH MODERATE VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (VWS) OF (10 TO 15 KNOTS), MODERATE TO STRONG POLEWARD UPPER-LEVEL OUTFLOW, AND WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (SSTS) OF 28 TO 29 C. GLOBAL DETERMINISTIC MODELS DEPICT A CLEARLY DEFINED CIRCULATION, THOUGH THE SYSTEM STRUGGLES TO MEET WIND SPEED CRITERIA AS IT TRAVERSES SOUTHWARD. ENSEMBLE MODELS DEPICT A SLOW DEVELOPMENT TREND OVER THE NEXT 24-36 HOURS. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 27 TO 32 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1006 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS REMAINS MEDIUM.

PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 7.7S 75.5E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 7.7S 75.3E, APPROXIMATELY 167 NM EAST OF DIEGO GARCIA. RECENT ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES PATCHY DEEP CONVECTION DEVELOPING OVER A DEVELOPING, ELONGATED LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION EVIDENT IN A 201620Z PARTIAL METOP-C ASCAT PASS. THIS DISTURBANCE LIES IN AN AREA OF LOW VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (5-10 KTS), FAVORABLE UPPER-LEVEL OUTFLOW, AND WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (29-30C). HOWEVER, THE DEVELOPING CIRCULATION IS STILL QUITE WEAK AND DISORGANIZED, AND DETERMINISTIC MODELS AND ENSEMBLES BOTH INDICATE SLOW DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT FEW DAYS AS THE SYSTEM TRACKS GENERALLY POLEWARD. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 13 TO 18 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1009 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS REMAINS LOW.
